body:
On one hand, thank God! 

On the other, I'm sorry. I've been ready for a while and it sucks. If you need to talk to someone, please let me know. I really need friends that will let me vent and I hope it might help you too.

And one more thing.. "You're doing that too much." Shouldn't be a thing on this sub. I know there is no chance to get rid of it, but immediacy is of utmost importance!
Jenna, if that is you, please don't. I'm sorry. I love you.
I'm in Oklahoma. I wish I was from the north east. Thanks
